summary: Iteration 3 validates Phase-1 SOC enhancement: multi-log + ZIP ingest, CES normalization, cross-log correlation. Extended pytest suite from 30 -> 42 tests (added TestBatchUpload with 10 tests + TestZipBombGuardConstant). All 42 pass. Playwright E2E confirms drop-zone format badges, 3-file bundle staging, batch upload run-through, per-file format/event badges in the job card ('apache·3, syslog·4, csv·3'), CorrelationPanel on IncidentDetail with corr-ip-* chips (incl. '45.155.205.199 3f · 7e'), 7-step attack chain, and full RBAC sidebar (analyst hides Review Queue + Settings, senior_reviewer shows Review Queue only, admin shows both). Legacy /api/logs/upload regression also verified in both backend and frontend flows. No regressions vs iteration_2.

minor.issue: Legacy single-upload has no explicit file-size cap (pre-existing, iteration_1).

Total-size cap uses MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES*2 (50MB) which is fine, but the per-file 25MB reject is validated only after full read into memory — for very large uploads this still buffers in RAM. Consider streaming/spooling. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py::upload_batch — MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=25MB enforced per file (413) and total capped at 50MB, aligning with spec. ZIP is detected via extension OR magic bytes b'PK' which is robust.
pipeline.py::_expand_zip — MAX_ZIP_MEMBERS=50 and MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES=50MB both enforced: skips over-large individual members AND breaks on cumulative overflow. Zip-bomb safe.

correlator.py — clean CES-shape agnostic correlation: entities (ip/user/host/domain/hash) are indexed and any entity in >=2 files OR >=3 events becomes a cross-link. attack_chain is built off the top anchor entity in chronological order. Verified: 3-file bundle with shared IP 45.155.205.199 produces 4 correlations and 7 chain steps (matches E1's manual test result).
correlator.py::_sort_key returns ('9999',) when timestamp is None → None entries sink to end; this is safe but consider ISO-8601 comparison stability across mixed timezone strings. Non-blocking.
CorrelationPanel.jsx imports Desktop from @phosphor-icons/react → verified icon exists in node_modules. No runtime import error.
Upload.jsx uses useCallback for submit/loadSampleBundle with correct deps; 3-file bundle creates real File objects and stages them correctly. clear-queue and staged-{idx} data-testids all present.

IncidentDetail.jsx conditionally renders <CorrelationPanel/> only when inc.correlation exists → legacy single-log incidents (no correlation object) still render cleanly. Verified indirectly (legacy pipeline delegates to batch and always produces a correlation object, but the guard is still there).

pipeline.run_batch_pipeline stores correlation under doc['correlation'] outside the strict Incident pydantic model — this works because insert_one takes a dict, but if a future refactor round-trips through Incident.model_validate the field will be dropped. Consider adding correlation to the Incident model. Non-blocking, flagged for design review.
